title: evals/scenarios/<fixture>.figures.json
description: Which approved golden gives which reference figure of the fixture. The first entry whose conditions all hold maps a golden.

figure.description: A figure name in the fixture's reference-figures.json.

golden.description: The golden's name: an exact name, a glob or re:<regex>, as scope patterns.

table.description: The table of the model of the request's first measure, or first dimension, as a scope pattern.

grouped.description: true when the request has dimensions, false when it returns one row.

key.description: For a figure with rows: its key column, compared with the request's first dimension.

value.description: For a figure with rows: its value column, compared with the request's first measure.
